en: A song, a psalm of Dovid.

he: נָכ֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה אַף־כְּבוֹדִֽי׃
en: Ready is my heart, Elokim; I shall sing and play, also my honor.
Awake, harp and lyre; I shall awake the dawn.
I shall thank You among peoples, Havayah; and I shall play to You among nations.
For great above the heavens is Your kindness, and to the skies Your truth.

he: ר֣וּמָה עַל־שָׁמַ֣יִם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֣רֶץ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
en: Exalted above the heavens, Elokim, and upon all the earth Your honor.

he: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
en: That Your beloved may be delivered, save Your right hand, and answer me.

he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקׇדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
en: Elokim spoke in His holiness: I shall exult, I shall divide Shechem, and the valley of Sukkot I shall measure.

he: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד ׀ לִ֤י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹקְקִֽי׃
en: Mine is Gilad, mine is Menasheh; and Ephraim is the stronghold of my head; Yehudah is my lawgiver.

he: מוֹאָ֤ב ׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עֲלֵי־פְ֝לֶ֗שֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָֽע׃
en: Moav is my washpot; upon Edom I shall cast my shoe; upon Peleshet I shall shout.

he: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מִבְצָ֑ר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־אֱדֽוֹם׃
en: Who shall bring me to the fortified city? Who led me to Edom?
Is it not Elokim who forsook us; and You do not go out, Elokim, with our hosts?

he: הָבָה־לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָֽם׃
en: Give us help from distress, and vain is the salvation of man.
In Elokim we shall do valor, and He shall tread our adversaries. A petuchah paragraph break.
